'''Tabac''' is a plant, widely cultivated for [[wikipedia:Pipe smoking|smoking]]. The leaves  are dried and cured for use in pipes, in which they are burned and the smoke from them inhaled.

[[Two Rivers]] tabac is generally acknowledged to be some of the best, from as far away as the [[Aiel Waste]].

==References==
* Tabac is an analogue to [[wikipedia:tobacco|tobacco]] in our world. It does not appear to have the same health effects, however.
